units.source_text: 右大弁年纪较长，桐壶帝时代早就在朝，圣眷优厚。

en.t: The Senior Controller of the Right was advanced in years, had served at court since Emperor Kiritsubo's reign, and had enjoyed the emperor's deep favor.

units.source_text: 此时他追怀故主，便吟诗道：

en.t: At this moment, remembering his late lord, he recited a poem:
